items.name: stellify-base
items.title: StellifyIT design system base
items.description: Canonical StellifyIT theme: emerald/teal/slate tokens (light + dark, oklch), Inter font, radius. Install first.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: MetricCard
items.description: KPI card: label, value, unit, delta with trend arrow, accent icon chip. invertDelta flips good/bad colors (for expenses).

items.name: chart-card
items.title: ChartCard
items.description: Card shell for charts with loading skeleton, empty and error states, header actions slot. All copy passed via props.

items.name: currency-display
items.title: CurrencyDisplay
items.description: Formats a number as currency via Intl.NumberFormat. locale + currency via props, no hardcoded language.

items.name: money-input
items.title: MoneyInput
items.description: Numeric input for monetary amounts with a currency adornment. Controlled, emits number values.

items.name: progress-ring
items.title: ProgressRing
items.description: SVG circular progress indicator. value/max/size/strokeWidth via props, themed with currentColor + muted track.

items.name: page-header
items.title: PageHeader
items.description: Page title + optional description + actions slot. Presentational only (no auth/theme/locale logic).

items.name: section-card
items.title: SectionCard
items.description: Card with a titled header, optional description, header actions slot and content area. Common panel shell.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: EmptyState
items.description: Centered empty/placeholder block: icon, title, description and optional action.

items.name: status-badge
items.title: StatusBadge
items.description: Badge with semantic status variants (success/warning/danger/info/neutral). Label via children.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: ConfirmDialog
items.description: Controlled confirmation dialog over AlertDialog. All copy via props; destructive flag for dangerous actions.

items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Presentational paginated table (columns, rows, sort, loading skeleton, empty state). Fetching is the consumer's job — see toolbar/pagination slots.

items.name: use-currency-format
items.title: useCurrencyFormat
items.description: Hook returning a memoized currency formatter (Intl.NumberFormat) for a given locale + currency.

items.name: use-persisted-state
items.title: usePersistedState
items.description: useState that persists to localStorage (JSON-serialized), SSR-safe.

items.name: week-dates
items.title: week-dates
items.description: Date helpers for weekly grids: start-of-week, week range, day labels. No external date library.

items.name: week-grid
items.title: WeekGrid / DayColumn
items.description: Presentational 7-day week grid with day columns. Events and rendering passed via props; no scheduling business logic.

items.name: utils
items.title: cn utility
items.description: `cn()` = clsx + tailwind-merge. Owned by this registry so installs never pull shadcn's upstream `utils`.

items.name: alert-dialog
items.title: AlertDialog
items.description: Radix alert dialog (vendored from shadcn so `confirm-dialog` never resolves upstream). Emits data-slot.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Table primitives (vendored from shadcn so `data-table` never resolves upstream). Emits data-slot.

items.name: button
items.title: Button (StellifyIT)
items.description: API-compatible superset of the shadcn button: primary/secondary/base hierarchy + success/warning/info, a loading spinner state, and a CRUD `mode` (create/edit/finish) that injects a semantic color and icon. Overwrites ui/button.

items.name: input
items.title: Input (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn input plus an invalid state (aria-invalid turns the border destructive). API-compatible; overwrites ui/input.

items.name: text-field
items.title: TextField
items.description: Labeled input with error/helper text and optional leading/trailing icons. Wires htmlFor/aria-invalid/aria-describedby. Copy via props.

items.name: data-table-pagination
items.title: DataTablePagination
items.description: Controlled pagination footer for data-table: page-size selector + prev/next. Labels via props. No paging logic.

items.name: data-table-toolbar
items.title: DataTableToolbar
items.description: Search box (with clear) + optional filters toggle and reset for data-table. Presentational; owns no filter state. Drop into the toolbar slot.

items.name: data-table-mobile
items.title: DataTableMobile
items.description: Card-per-row mobile view reusing data-table's columns. Pair with data-table behind a breakpoint. Includes loading skeletons + empty slot.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge (StellifyIT)
items.description: Badge with variants plus `size` (default | xs) and `uppercase`. Emits data-slot.

items.name: card
items.title: Card (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn card primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/card.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn dialog primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/dialog.

items.name: select
items.title: Select (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn select primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/select.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn tabs primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/tabs.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn checkbox primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/checkbox.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn switch primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/switch.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn tooltip primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/tooltip.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: DropdownMenu (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn dropdown-menu primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/dropdown-menu.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn popover primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/popover.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn calendar primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/calendar.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea (StellifyIT)
items.description: Textarea with `autoResize` (grows with content). Emits data-slot.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn separator primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/separator.

items.name: label
items.title: Label (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn label primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/label.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn progress primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/progress. `size="sm"`: thin bar on a neutral track.

items.name: form
items.title: Form (StellifyIT)
items.description: Standard shadcn form primitive, shipped under @stellify for apps without shadcn. Overwrites ui/form.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: Generic card carousel: autoplay, hover-pause, drag/swipe, responsive slides-per-view, arrows + dots. Pass items + renderItem.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart (StellifyIT)
items.description: shadcn chart primitive: ChartContainer/ChartTooltip/ChartLegend over Recharts, wired to stellify-base chart tokens. Overwrites ui/chart.

items.name: chart-area
items.title: Area chart
items.description: Area chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-bar
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: Bar chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-line
items.title: Line chart
items.description: Line chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-pie
items.title: Pie / donut chart
items.description: Pie / donut chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-radar
items.title: Radar chart
items.description: Radar chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-radial
items.title: Radial chart
items.description: Radial chart built on the chart primitive + Recharts, using stellify-base chart-N tokens. Demo data inside — edit freely.

items.name: chart-formatters
items.title: chart-formatters
items.description: Intl-based value/currency/date/number formatters for chart tooltips, legends and axis ticks. Pure, no React.

items.name: use-series-toggle
items.title: useSeriesToggle
items.description: Visibility state for an interactive chart legend (click series to show/hide).

items.name: time-range-selector
items.title: TimeRangeSelector
items.description: Segmented time-range control (7d/30d/90d/All) + getRangeBounds() helper. i18n-agnostic. For chart headers.

items.name: power-chart
items.title: PowerChart
items.description: Configurable dashboard-grade chart over the chart primitive: thresholds (reference lines), interactive legend, Intl tooltips/axes, brush + time-range, and loading/empty/error states. type=area|bar|line|pie|radar|radial.

items.name: month-year-picker
items.title: MonthYearPicker
items.description: Native month input (YYYY-MM) wrapper, themed. Controlled via month (1-12) + year.

items.name: date-picker-field
items.title: DatePickerField
items.description: Button + calendar popover date field. Emits ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Locale via prop.

items.name: loading-spinner
items.title: LoadingSpinner
items.description: Centered spinner; fullScreen option for route-level loading. size/label props.

items.name: category-tag
items.title: CategoryTag
items.description: Colored badge resolving Parent / Child category hierarchy from a list. Copy via props.

items.name: logo
items.title: Logo
items.description: StellifyIT wordmark (SVG, currentColor). height/width/title/ariaHidden props.

items.name: form-modal
items.title: FormModal
items.description: Reusable CRUD form modal (react-hook-form + zod): text/number/date/select/color/switch fields, two-column layout, create/update handlers. Copy via props; onNotify for toasts.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: DateRangePicker
items.description: Range calendar popover with presets, Apply/Cancel, side-by-side months, and an optional date↔datetime switch that unlocks start/end time pickers (default 00:00). Emits ISO { from, to } (with THH:mm when time is on).

items.name: time-picker
items.title: TimePicker
items.description: Hour + minute selects (+ AM/PM unless use24Hour). Controlled, emits 24h 'HH:mm'. minuteStep configurable.

items.name: overflow-marquee
items.title: OverflowMarquee
items.description: Truncates with an ellipsis at rest and, only when the text actually overflows, slides horizontally on hover/focus to reveal the full string, easing back on leave. Self-contained (measures its own overflow, pure CSS transform, no Tailwind config). Honors reduced motion; keeps a native title fallback.

items.name: number-compare
items.title: NumberCompare
items.description: Two-sided numeric comparison: lower bound (>, ≥) AND upper bound (<, ≤), e.g. '> 2 and < 10'. Either side optional. Emits { lower, upper }.

items.name: intelui-types
items.title: intelUI types
items.description: Shared presentational types for the intelUI assistant pieces (messages, tabs, conversations, actions). Engine-agnostic.

items.name: intelui-pill
items.title: InteluiPill
items.description: Bottom-of-sidebar assistant pill: nav-item styling, fading label, highlighted when intelUI is active. Opens the assistant dropdown. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-conversation-list
items.title: InteluiConversationList
items.description: Selectable conversation history list with per-row delete cross (reveals on hover). Props-only, i18n-agnostic.

items.name: intelui-tabs
items.title: InteluiTabs
items.description: Horizontal scrollable tab strip for open conversations: per-tab close cross + a new-conversation button. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-chat-panel
items.title: InteluiChatPanel
items.description: Upward-expanding transcript panel: context header, tab strip, suggestion chips and message log. max-height transition. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-floating-bar
items.title: InteluiFloatingBar
items.description: Floating assistant input bar: portaled, anchored to the sidebar edge via --intelui-sidebar-w, grows from the icon. Send/stop (spinner+cancel), focus suggestions, caret-up chat panel. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-dropdown
items.title: InteluiDropdown
items.description: Assistant popover content in two groups: Actions (Sparkles/Zap) and Conversations (Clock, deletable history), plus the intelUI switch. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-highlight
items.title: intelUI highlight layer
items.description: Assistant-actionable highlight: --intelui-accent token + a soft persistent outline on [data-intelui-actionable], reinforced on hover/focus and when [data-selected]. Respects reduced motion. Pairs with the Actionable wrapper.

items.name: actionable
items.title: Actionable
items.description: Domain-agnostic wrapper that marks an entity as assistant-actionable: paints data-intelui-actionable / data-intelui-type / data-selected for the intelui-highlight layer. asChild (Slot) merges markers onto the child without an extra node or competing handlers. Props-only.

items.name: intelui-chip
items.title: InteluiChip
items.description: Removable selected-entity chip for the assistant input: label + trailing ✕, --intelui-accent border, data-intelui-type accent. Props-only.

items.name: site-nav
items.title: SiteNav
items.description: Public site navigation with an accessible mobile menu (focus trap, Escape to close). Links are real anchors so they stay crawlable.

items.name: site-chat
items.title: SiteChat
items.description: Public chat panel, degraded-first: renders a FAQ block by default and gains a composer when a service is available. Never shows a raw error or an indefinite spinner.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: SiteFooter
items.description: Site footer with grouped link columns and a legal line. Real anchors — it doubles as the crawlable link graph.

items.name: profile-intro
items.title: ProfileIntro
items.description: "Who" block: photo with explicit dimensions, name, role and track record.

items.name: offer-card
items.title: OfferCard
items.description: Service card: deliverable, when it fits, and a link to the work that backs it. No hover-to-reveal.

items.name: process-steps
items.title: ProcessSteps
items.description: Numbered steps rendered as an ordered list.

items.name: long-form-article
items.title: LongFormArticle
items.description: Long-form page body: intro, optional status badge and figures, h2 sections with pull-outs, stack chips and related links. Content is plain strings, never markup.

items.name: data-table-filters
items.title: DataTableFilters
items.description: Filter type system for DataTable: 10 filter kinds, operators, state shapes, type guards and factory helpers. No UI.

items.name: data-table-filter-widget
items.title: DataTableFilterWidget
items.description: Renders the control for one filter definition — text, number, ranges, date, datetime, select, multiselect and async column values.

items.name: data-table-column-filter
items.title: DataTableColumnFilter
items.description: Filter trigger for a column header: an icon that opens the column's filter in a popover, so a wide control is not bound to the column's width.

items.name: data-table-active-filters
items.title: DataTableActiveFilters
items.description: Chips showing which filters are applied; each reopens its filter for editing and clears itself.

items.name: step-heading
items.title: StepHeading
items.description: Onboarding step title (h1) + grey subtitle.

items.name: onboarding-shell
items.title: OnboardingShell
items.description: Multi-step onboarding frame: logo + "Paso n de N", thin progress bar, centered ~580 px column.

items.name: nav-footer
items.title: NavFooter
items.description: "← Atrás" link + primary "Siguiente →" for step flows; labels, disabled, loading and submit type as props.

items.name: number-input
items.title: NumberInput
items.description: Controlled numeric input (empty = null) with a vertical ± stepper, min/max clamping and translatable button labels.

items.name: choice-card
items.title: ChoiceCard
items.description: Single-choice block options (Radix radio group): title + description, selected = primary border + check.

items.name: textarea-field
items.title: TextareaField
items.description: Labeled textarea with required asterisk, error and helper text (multi-line sibling of text-field).

items.name: quadrant-grid
items.title: QuadrantGrid
items.description: 2×2 grid with column headers and vertical row labels; exactly four children.

items.name: quadrant-cell
items.title: QuadrantCell
items.description: Quadrant cell: icon, uppercase code, title, description; `active` adds a primary border and a "Tu vía" badge.

items.name: reason-list
items.title: ReasonList
items.description: List of short justifications, each with a primary check.

items.name: app-shell
items.title: AppShell
items.description: App frame: fixed left sidebar (collapsible), optional top bar, scrollable main.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Vertical app nav: Sidebar, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarItem (icon, active = aria-current, trailing slot, asChild for router links).
